_description: BOARDS-AI Case Data Schema — Each JSON file in this directory represents one radiology case.
_instructions: To add your own cases: create a new .json file following this exact structure. Replace placeholder values with your own case data. The 'Case Images' array should contain base64-encoded images with the data-URI prefix.

Heading.description: The diagnosis or condition name. This is the 'True Answer' passed to the LLM as context for question generation. It is never shown to the examinee.

Presentation.description: Clinical vignette: patient age, gender, symptoms, and relevant history. This IS shown to the examinee via the question stem.

items.findings: string — radiology report-style description of what the images show. Passed to LLM but NOT shown to examinee.

items.title: string — article title
items.text: string — full article text (used as reference for LLM question generation)
items.references: object — key-value pairs of citation strings from the article

Citation.description: Attribution string for the case images and data.

items.caption: string — brief description of the image (e.g., 'Axial non-contrast CT')

uid.description: Unique numeric identifier for the case.
